verdict.rationale: BILL publishes a developer portal with endpoint-level API documentation, code recipes covering AP, AR and S&E, and a sandbox for testing workflows without moving real money. That gives a documented reference with examples, but nothing in the pack shows an interactive 'try it' console or examples that run in place. The OpenAPI probes all returned 404, so there is no machine-readable spec either. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive in-browser API explorer, runnable/executable examples in the reference, a published OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.
